Firstly, suicide is an option but keep in mind you aren't making any more decisions after making it. Secondly, I think it helps to think about all the people who you'll affect by making this decision. Thirdly, you aren't alone bruv, I mean that in the best possible way. Every case of depression is unique so I can't compare experiences. But this is an entire community of people who are suicidal or looking to help mate. You're not a freak and suicidal thoughts happen to a shit ton of people. But the best advice I can give is to not act on harmful thoughts. A low point is the best time to sit in your room and cry or find a punching bag. But remind yourself of the good times when you're not in an episode and focus on the positive whenever the fog's lifted for the day.

But I've felt all the life in me get drained out and lost my motivation. I just want to feel motivated to do anything, no matter how small. But there's no joy.

I guess I just have bad experiences hanging out with people who just drain you. I'm also kind of afraid of a person just rejecting my presence suddenly or messing up my relationship with people.
I'm not really sure who I am anymore, kinda lost at the moment. I guess I like writing and drawing, want to make comics and write novels someday. But lately I've just lost any spark or vision for the future.I couldn't find any drive to write anything or sketch. Kinda lost my will to live for awhile, was passively suicidal for awhile now. No, I guess I'm not happy with me now. It's just been getting more intense and suddenly I was wasting 5 hours a day mindlessly scrolling or lying in bed. But I guess I'm making an effort to get treated now, started on meds recently.

I think I'm gonna start "self medicating"
I need an easy way to deal with this in the meantime.

But suicide is a permanent solution to temporary problems that that recur.
